title: Ownership Proof
description: Sale deed, gift deed, or registered document proving ownership.

title: 7/12 Extract or Property Card
description: Latest 7/12 extract from Talathi or Property Card (PR card) from City Survey office.

title: N.A. Order
description: Non-Agricultural (N.A.) usage permission order from the Collector.

title: Licensed Architect's Certificate
description: Certificate from PMC licensed Architect / Engineer.

title: Fire NOC
description: No Objection Certificate from the Fire Department (if applicable).

title: Tree NOC
description: No Objection Certificate from the Tree Authority (if applicable).

title: Drainage NOC
description: NOC from PMC Drainage department for connection.
